name: FUN_DOCIO_AL_MAPPINGS
description: This table contains transformation mappings from source fingerprint to target structure, derived from Adaptive Learning.

columns.name: FINGERPRINT_ID
columns.description: The source fingerprint to be transformed from.

columns.name: TRANSFORM_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the transformation in Adaptive Learning.

columns.name: TARGET_STRUCTURE_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the target document structure. The target document structure to be transformed to.

columns.name: MAPPED_ATTRIBUTE_METADATA
columns.description: Mapped attribute metadata for the mapping.

columns.name: UNMAPPED_ATTRIBUTE_METADATA
columns.description: Unmapped attribute metadata for the mapping.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates status of a user mapping metadata document. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_FUN_DOCIO_MAPPING_STATUSES.

columns.name: CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Indicates condition ID of a user mapping metadata document.

columns.name: MAPPING_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: To store the version number of the accepted user mapping metadata document..

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
